SMTO-GML-0024 — Gmail is unavailable because saved account storage is off

GUID: 38aa4032-bc92-4b01-9129-26c1964ccaed
Slug: gmail-parameter-store-disabled
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • SMTO keeps your connected Gmail accounts in its Parameter Store, and that storage is switched off on this installation, so Gmail can't be used. Your saved accounts aren't deleted; they just can't be reached right now.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Tell the person who manages SMTO that Gmail reports the Parameter Store is turned off, and send them the copied error details. Only someone who manages the SMTO server can change this setting.
  2. After they turn it back on and restart SMTO, open the Parameter Store page and check that your Gmail account entry is listed. Seeing your account there shows SMTO can reach its saved accounts again.
  3. Then ask SMTO to try your Gmail request again. Gmail starts working as soon as the saved account storage is available.

What success looks like

  • The Parameter Store page shows your Gmail account, and SMTO can search your Gmail again.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete or recreate your Gmail account entries to work around this; they are kept safely while the storage is off.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • GmailService construction failed because agent_parameter_store_enabled is false (AOR_AGENT_PARAMETER_STORE_ENABLED), and Gmail requires the Parameter Store for account and authorization records.

What this means

  • Gmail service construction observes agent_parameter_store_enabled false. Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.

Why this can happen

  • Gmail service construction observes agent_parameter_store_enabled false.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect effective Parameter Store enablement before changing OAuth credentials.

How to fix it

  • GmailService.init raises gmail_parameter_store_disabled when settings.agent_parameter_store_enabled is false. Set AOR_AGENT_PARAMETER_STORE_ENABLED=true (or remove the override) in the Server environment and restart the Server, then confirm the Parameter Store page lists the Gmail Account entries.
  • Enable or restore the supported Parameter Store account configuration path.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended supported account store is enabled and its profiles are available.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
